# Agent Eval Protocol Suite

This workspace exists only for the reusable eval protocol runs.

It is intended for:
- harmless eval-file creation
- local app/code generation for testing
- saved research outputs
- browser and desktop verification flows

Safe assumptions for protocol evals:
- writing new `*.txt`, `*.py`, `*.html`, and eval-only app folders here is acceptable
- opening files created here is acceptable
- no production code depends on this directory
